lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Concept model A: assumptions and constraints

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Study both examples. The second one drops some of the wording of the first.

items.prompt: A model predicts a $80 rate will increase by 25%. What is the new rate?

steps: Identify what the problem is asking and which quantities, assumptions, or constraints matter.
Build and solve a model, then check the result against the context.

items.prompt: A storage container is 4 by 3 by 2 feet. What is its volume in cubic feet?

steps: Identify what the problem is asking and which quantities, assumptions, or constraints matter.
Build and solve a model, then check the result against the context.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A data set has the values 39, 44, 49, 54, 59. The mean is 49. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 3 by 7 by 7 units has a volume of 153 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: No; the volume is 147 cubic units, not 153.
Cannot be determined from the given information.
No; the volume is 155 cubic units, not 153.
No; the volume is 154 cubic units, not 153.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $11 base fee plus $2 per hour. A customer's total bill was $37. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 9 m, then descends another 7 m, then ascends 7 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 25 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?
A model predicts a $840 rate will increase by 20%. What does the model predict as the new rate?
A storage container is designed as a rectangular prism 11 ft long, 4 ft wide, and 4 ft high. What is its volume in cubic feet?
A data set has the values 27, 32, 37, 42, 47. The mean is 37. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: A student claims a box that is 6 by 2 by 3 units has a volume of 12 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: No; the volume is 36 cubic units, not 12.
Cannot be determined from the given information.
Yes; the volume is 12 cubic units.
No; the volume is 13 cubic units, not 12.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $4 base fee plus $4 per hour. A customer's total bill was $56. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?
